records.title: Transport feature-bit preservation across all non-legacy transports
records.source: inferred — from source (compensation asymmetry across transports)
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: All non-legacy transports must preserve device-offered transport feature bits (28..41) that vring_transport_features cannot enumerate.

records.title: Whitelist enumeration or compensator coverage for every supported transport feature bit
records.source: inferred — from source (closed-set enumeration vs authoritative header)
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: vring_transport_features must enumerate or have a compensator for every transport feature bit any transport supports.

records.title: NOTIF_CONFIG_DATA(39) survival on any transport whose finalize validates it
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: NOTIF_CONFIG_DATA(39) must survive negotiation on any transport whose finalize validates it.

records.title: Negotiation acceptance confirmed for VERSION_1 devices and intentionally absent for legacy
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Negotiation acceptance is confirmed for VERSION_1 devices and intentionally absent for legacy.

records.title: Device-reset write-0-then-wait-for-status-0 parity across transports
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Every transport's device-reset path must satisfy the spec section 5 write-0-then-wait-for-status-0 contract, or document an intentional legacy exemption.

records.title: IRQ_HANDLED return from every handler that serviced a config-change interrupt
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Every transport interrupt handler must return IRQ_HANDLED when it serviced a config-change interrupt, independent of vring activity.

records.title: Packed-ring wrap-counter and avail/used descriptor flags toggle together on ring wrap
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Packed-ring wrap-counter and avail/used descriptor flags must toggle together on ring wrap.

records.title: Descriptor writes ordered before the index update that publishes them
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Every descriptor write must be ordered before the index update that publishes it.

records.title: Driver-requested virtqueue size bounded by the device-advertised maximum
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Driver-requested virtqueue size must not exceed the device-advertised maximum.
